list: The official 55 trophies, as shown on PlayStation Network (names, descriptions and grades verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase / PSNProfiles via PlanetGTA6, and against Push Square's full list). Guides are this entry's own words; where a fact comes from a published guide it is cited per trophy and on the Sources page.

sources.name: Official trophy list on PlayStation Network
sources.via: Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide (platinum difficulty and time, missable and cheat notes)
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies: all 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is the last trophy by definition. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, then the collectible and activity clean-up, and finally 100% completion.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it unlocks as the story begins and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, remember the one missable warning on this list: a meditation spot in Chapter 1 is reported to disappear afterwards, so keep a manual save (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2. Both protagonists are playable from here, which opens up most of the side activities on this list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the final mission. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida in free roam, and the game hands you its 100% Completion checklist, so nothing after this point is locked behind the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The game gives you a 100% Completion checklist after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion, per Push Square). You do not need literally everything — for example only 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count — but expect most of the trophies on this list to be done first. This is the long grind of the platinum and the reason the estimates run into the hundreds of hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in total across four types — Stunt Jumps (130), Under the Bridges (202), Knife Flights (40) and Base Jumps (25) — so you need just over half of them (Push Square). Track your progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts; discovered spots show under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once (Push Square). Sample everything early — races, shooting ranges, fishing, the arcade, drones, stunts and the rest — and this pops during normal play without any grinding.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (Push Square). There are two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them at Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet other conditions, which the map shows.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, some with entry fees (Push Square). Check them at Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating one race does not count — it has to be 20 distinct race locations (Push Square). Track them at Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating can be raised with Mod Shop upgrades.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg; fish the marked area until one of the right size bites (Push Square). You need a boat with a fishing rod — plenty can be borrowed in the area.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start any game on it and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — finish all of Andy's stranger missions in order and this pops at the end of his strand (Push Square).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His strand ends with the mission Maritime Disputes (Push Square).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His strand ends with the mission Hometown Heroes (Push Square).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Work through the stranger missions — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the rest — and each finished strand counts toward the eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His strand revolves around his vehicle wish list (Push Square) — keep an eye out for the cars he wants as you explore.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His strand involves the Kitty Litter Lab (Push Square).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation locations in total (Push Square). A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played; track them under Progress, Collections, Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: published guides report one early spot (Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1) disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (Output Lag, reporting PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Finish Bret's stranger strand; the hunt target is one specific animal, so follow Bret's missions rather than hunting at random.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in Leonida and you need every card in 3 of them (Push Square). Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress. Track them at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Going for 100% completion needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the app on Jason's or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open the phone); scan landmarks (31 of them), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) around Leonida (Push Square). Track your count at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 Challenges in the game, and 100% completion needs 70 of them (Push Square). View them all, with their requirements, at Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges, and pick off the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level to 4 stars while your partner is with you — during a mission or in free roam — then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops, rob them in one run with your partner, and keep the wanted level alive the whole time — if it drops, the chain resets.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it (Push Square), so this should pop during normal story play. Track which ones you have found at Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus and drop five before it ends — pick a spot where enemies cluster together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The official description is deliberately vague, and no published guide has yet pinned down an exact repeatable step for this one — it is a hidden trophy about leaving Vice City International Airport in an unplanned way. Try it around the VCIA missions and check your trophy list afterwards.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The official description is a joke, not an instruction — it involves the Rhino tank, and no published guide has yet confirmed the exact trigger. Treat it as a free-roam experiment once tanks are available and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — and get out clean. If you are spotted the attempt fails; leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape. This is the only silver robbery trophy on the list, which tells you it is the hardest of the set — plan each vault properly instead of rushing them.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open and get away before the wanted level catches up with you.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk the whole map until every region registers as visited — it pops once the last area is covered. Pair it with the collectible hunts so the driving does double duty.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations; hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, not a mission. It pops once the scene plays out.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. A showroom moment — drive out through the glass, the way the series has always done it. The exact showroom is not yet pinned down in published guides, so try the showrooms you find while exploring Vice City.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through (Push Square).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description gives no step — this is a hidden trophy tied to how your partnership plays out, and no published guide has pinned down a repeatable trigger yet. It appears to unlock through story and side play rather than a checklist task.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). A hidden trophy about the choices you make in the story — it pops from a decision, not a checklist item. Which choice, no published guide has yet confirmed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A hidden trophy that suggests failing at something once, then succeeding on the retry — the exact moment is not yet confirmed in published guides.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy for a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida. The description is the whole clue; no published guide has pinned down the trigger yet, so treat it as one to watch for while exploring.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. At the bowling alley, knock the pins over with a melee drive-by instead of a ball (Push Square).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It adds up across the whole game, so the vault and truck robberies feed it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Just spend — clothes, food, gear, anything in any shop; it adds up across the whole game (Push Square). Find shops on the map at Touch Pad, Style. The garage purchases for Little Boxes also help the total along.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages, $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800 (Push Square). Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up). Each adds one parking spot, which you also need for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register a vehicle at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — you need a free parking spot for each (Push Square). Ten different vehicles, and Scooter Bros will then deliver them to you for a small fee. Buy garages first if you run out of spots.
trophies.name: On the Spot
